notes.title: June Next Fest & Dev Log
notes.content:
Hey all, Hope everyone is doing well. I wanted to announce that "Anime Collector: Evo" will be F2P over the Steam Next Fest starting on 10th of June.

As a solo developer on this project it is hard for me to keep the Steam community updated on the current progress. I provide updates on our discord server far more regularly then I do Steam but when anything important comes to light I will also update Steam.

So in this Announcement i wanted to bring everyone who is not on our Discord server up to date on my work along with sharing some credits with some of my amazing artists that have helped me along the way and continue to provide there support!

[u](Please note that while the following is planned for June some stuff may be delayed for later updates)[/u]
[u](As the game is in EA content and gameplay is always subject to change)[/u]
[b]Dev Log:[/b]

[b]Character Lore:[/b] 
Currently, most non-player characters (NPCs) in the game serve primarily as sources for side quests rather than offering extensive lore or insights into the game world. However, beginning in June, there will be a significant shift with the arrival of newly introduced NPCs designed to enrich player experience in the game universe.

Initially, I planned to incorporate character lore through dialogue or storytelling. However, I've decided to take a more unconventional approach. When you first engage with an important NPC, you'll encounter a prompt: "Read memory..." Choosing this option will unveil the NPC's lore in the form of a manga. Some stories will be short, while others may span many pages. For instance, "Riko" will have approximately five pages dedicated to her backstory.

Skipping this option is possible, but doing so means the character's lore won't be added to your collection, and you won't have another opportunity to learn about them. Reading the lore will reward you with a new item in your Steam inventory: "DATA CORE: <NPC_NAME>." Conversely, skipping the lore will grant you a "CORRUPT CORE: <NPC_NAME>." I won't delve into the implications further at this point, but these choices will significantly influence your gameplay with that NPC and the rewards you receive.

"Riko"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40197745/f4f79329df4e0024d5118fbdaa6cf9952829369f.png[/img]


[b]Up-coming Bosses:[/b]
My boss system has been re-developed from the ground up. The new system allows me to easily create diverse abilities and movement sets for the games boss battles.

"Liquid Lust"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40197745/19264a05c76ecbddff7b17535c797b296eafc574.jpg[/img]

"Lunara Avalonis"

[b]Global Events:[/b]
Global Events are introducing a fresh dynamic into the game, replacing traditional boss gate encounters entirely. Participants must collaboratively gather required resources to access designated zones where adventure awaits. These zones may contain bosses or lead to treasure troves filled with numerous chest discoveries. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40197745/205b14863f69de49caf5b423d905032395046889.jpg[/img]


[b]End Log[/b]
I just want to thank everyone for following the project and supporting me. I appreciate every single one of you. 

If you would like to be updated more regularly on the game it would be great if you could join the games [url=https://discord.gg/n4yRYchp]DISCORD[/url]

notes.title: Client-Server Update Released!
notes.content:
A new patch is now available on Steam. With this update, both the client and server can handle multiple stacks of items.

Previously, the game could only recognize one stack of any particular item. This limitation is now resolved. Players no longer have to consolidate their items into a single stack - the client and server will efficiently manage multiple stacks!

notes.title: Christmas Event
notes.content:
🎄[b]Happy Christmas![/b] 🎄

I hope you're all ready for a festive season filled with joy and cheer. I'm thrilled to announce that Anime Collector Evo's Christmas event kicks off December 25, 2023, at 4 PM AEDT! 🎅🌟

[b]Special Access Offer:[/b] Haven't joined the Anime Collector Evo world yet? For tomorrow only, ping [u]@Developers[/u] or [u]@Squids Around[/u] in ⁠our [url=https://discord.gg/a8eFqeu8]discord server[/url] , and I'll personally ensure you get a key to the universe. Please be patient; I'll work my magic to get your key as soon as possible! 🗝️✨

[b]Attention Newcomers:[/b] As our valued testers, your feedback is vital in enhancing our new database system. Keep in mind that as we evolve, some features might be in flux, but your insights help me create a better experience for everyone. 🛠️🔄

🔔 [b]Exciting Patch Notes: [/b]🔔

+[NEW ZONE] SkyVillage: A festive wonderland awaits in the Xmas Event Zone!
+[NEW ENEMY] Snow Monster: Brace yourself for frosty foes!
+[NEW ORE] Crimson Ice: Discover and gather this chilly resource!
+[NEW CURRENCY] Christmas Coin: Collect and spend these special festive tokens!
+[UPGRADE] Resource Gathering System: Say goodbye to tedious 'E' pressing – now just aim and shoot to gather!

While i've made significant progress, some anticipated features need more polish and will be introduced in the next update, including:

- Fair Loot Distribution: No more loot snatching in non-PVP zones!
- Enhanced Audio Experience: Get ready for auditory delight!
- Thrilling PVP Arena: Test your skills against other players!
- Evo Cities Market Area: A new hub for trading and interacting with NPCs!

Thank you all for being part of this journey with me. Your support and enthusiasm are what drive the continuous growth and improvement of Anime Collector Evo. Let's dive into this festive adventure together! ❤️🎮

notes.title: THANK YOU ALL
notes.content:
Thanks to each of you for coming out to the event. Your participation has provided a treasure trove of data that's going to make our new database even better.

I'm thrilled with the stability we've seen—no server crashes and no database overloads, which is a big step up. This means we might just keep the servers live round-the-clock again before long.

I'm in the middle of a bit of a tidy-up on the server side and polishing off my admin tools, making it way easier to manage things on my end.

[u][b]And a fair warning for the future: starting with the next patch, any form of cheating, scripting, or botting won't be tolerated. Get caught, and you'll be banned with your Steam inventory wiped out.[/b][/u]

[b]Just so you know, the server will be going down at 4 PM AEST today.[/b]

notes.title: FIRST DATABASE TEST & DEADWOOD EVENT
notes.content:
This patch signifies a substantial advancement for the game, introducing a new database that will enable player data to be retained across not just one, but multiple servers and regions. Alongside the database trial, I am also launching our first community Halloween event(I realize it's a tad late... yet better late than never)

To partake in the event, initially find the gateway to "Deadwood". Upon entering Deadwood, search for a code nestled somewhere within the map which can now be redeemed for a novel Unique item.

[b][ADDED] Database
[ADDED] REDEEM CODE SYSTEM
[ADDED] DEADWOOD
[ADDED] ENEMY - PUMPKIN HEAD[/b]

To seize your complimentary item for engaging in the event, first hop onto the server and utilize code "DBTEST" to claim your bounty.

The enemy "Pumpkin Heads" possess a chance to relinquish a scarce pumpkin head hat.

Best of luck to all, and I am eager to encounter you in-game.

[b]The server kicks off at 4PM AEST today and the Steam update has been released. The servers will be live from now to 7/11/2023[/b]

[i]This event is only open to those who already own the game and are currently "EVO TESTERS" in our discord server.[/i]

Please note that you should expect many new systems to have issues as this is the first time that i am testing the new database on a large scale. I am using this event as a way to find bugs relating to the new database system and improve it for other events in the future.

[url=https://discord.gg/GzJ9M26JFA][b]Discord Server[/b][/url]

Thank you all for your continued support <3
